project: The Legend of Peach: A Mario to the Mushroom Kingdom
release: v0.10.0 — Super Mario Adventure Beyond Limits
scoring_policy: Independent 14-dimension rubric. Every dimension has its own uncoupled formula, numerator/denominator, validation tier, and explicit honest limitations. No dimension is derived by trivial subtraction from another, and physical SNES hardware is NEVER assumed passed without real console execution.
why_v0100_not_v100: Physical SNES / Super Famicom / FXPAK Pro console execution is 0/1 (NOT_TESTED locally).

A continuous 100% blank-SRAM start-to-credits full playthrough across all 11 dungeons without room-warp harnesses has not yet been completed (opening chapter + save/reboot is PLAYTHROUGH_PASS; all 12 bosses & 4-biome warp chain are VISUAL_PASS).
Additional reference emulators (Ares, standalone bsnes GUI, Snes9x, Mesen 2) are not installed on this build host.
